_comment: Display rules for GeoNames places. 'places': per geonames_id, 'names' replaces the shown name per language, 'country_code' the country, 'tz' the time zone. 'regions': rules for every place in the listed admin1 codes (and listed places). Searching still uses every GeoNames name. Read at startup; no database rebuild needed.

616051._what: Yerevan (region). GeoNames only has the classical spelling Երէվան.

regions._what: Artsakh at its 1994–2020 extent. Founder's decisions (2026-11-23): wherever GeoNames has an Armenian name, show it in every language (transliterated where there is no English or Russian spelling); keep the country as GeoNames gives it; use Armenian time for every place here. Baku and Yerevan clocks differed for 1,603 days (1992-96, 2012-15) and agree otherwise. Whole districts: Khankendi, Shusha, Shusha City, Khojaly, Khojavend, Kalbajar, Lachin, Qubadli, Zangilan, Jabrayil. Districts cut by the line of contact are listed place by place in 'places', approximated by longitude: Tartar west of 46.87 E, Agdam west of 46.99 E, Fuzuli west of 47.18 E (plus Martakert). Approximate: check against a map of the 1994-2020 line.

Armenian villages of the former Soviet Shahumyan district (now in Goranboy), claimed by Artsakh. Founder's decision (2026-11-23): Armenian names in every language. Time zone unchanged (Baku): Azerbaijan held the area from mid-1992, before the Baku and Yerevan clocks first differed. Villages chosen: Goranboy places with an Armenian name in GeoNames, west of 46.69 E and south of 40.5 N. Check against a map.
